spans.s:
औपकर्णिक a. (की f.) [
उपकर्णठक्] Being near the ears.

औपकार्यं, --र्या [उपकार्य-अण्] A
residence, a tent.

औपकार्यं, --र्या [उपकार्य-अण्] A
residence, a tent.

औपग्रस्तिकः --ग्रहिकः [उपग्रस्त-ग्रह
ठञ्]
1 An eclipse.
--2 The sun or
moon in eclipse.

औपग्रस्तिकः --ग्रहिकः [उपग्रस्त-ग्रह
ठञ्]
1 An eclipse.
--2 The sun or
moon in eclipse.

औपचारिक a. (की f.) [
उपचारठक्] Metaphorical, figurative;
secondary (opp. मुख्य).
--कं
Figurative application.

औपच्छंदसिकं N. of a metre;
see App.

औपजानुक a. (की f.) [
उपजानुठक्] Being near the knees.

औपदेशिक a. (की f.) [उपदेश
ठक्]
1 Living by उपदेश or teaching.
--2 Got by instruction (as wealth).

औपद्रविक a. (की f.) [
उपद्रवठक्] Relating to, or treating of,
symptoms (of diseases).

औपद्रष्ट्र्यं [उपद्रष्टृ-ष्यञ्]
1
Superintendence.
--2 The state of being
an eye-witness.

औपधर्म्यं [उपधर्म-ष्यञ्]
1 A
false doctrine, heresy.
--2 Inferior
virtue, or a degraded principle of
virtue.

औपधिक a. (की f.) Deceitful,
deceptive.

औपाधिक a. (की f.) [
उपाधिठञ्]
1 Conditional.
--2 Pertaining
to attributes or properties; an effect
produced.

औपधेय a. (यी f.) [
उपधिठञ्] Serving for the part of the
wheel of a carriage called उपधि, q. v.
--यं The wheel of a carriage (रथांगं).

औपनायनिक a. (की f.) [
उपनयनठक्] Relating to or serving for
उपनयन (the rite of investiture with
the sacred thread);

औपनासिक (की f.) [उपनास
ठञ्] Being near the nose.

औपनिषत्क a. (की f.) [
उपनिषदा जीवति ठक्] Living by
(teaching) the Upaniṣads.

औपनिषद a. (दी f.)
[उपनिषद्-अण्]
1 Contained or taught in an
Upaniṣad; scriptural,
theological.
--2 Based or founded on,
derived from, the Upaniṣads;
औपनिषदं दर्शनं (another name for
Vedānta phil.)
--दः
1 The supreme soul,
Brahman.
--2 A follower of the
doctrines of the Upaniṣads.

औपनीविक a. (की f.) [
उपनीवि-ठक्] Being or placed near
नीवि (the knot of the wearing garment)
(of males or females), बद्धो
दुर्बलरक्षार्थमसिर्येनौपनीविकः

;
औपनीविकमरुंद्ध किल स्त्री (करं) Śi. 10. 60.

औपपक्ष्य [उपपक्ष-ष्यञ्] Being in
the arm pit.

औपपत्तिक a. (की f.) [
उपपत्ति-ठक्]
1 Ready at hand, within
reach.
--2 Fit, proper.
--3
Theoretical.

औपपातिक a. (की f.) [
उपपातठक्] One who has committed an
Upapātaka, q. v.

औपभृत a. (ती f.) [उपभृत्-अल्]
Being in the ladle (as an
offering).

औपमिक a. (की f.) [उपमा-ठक्]
1 Serving for a simile or
comparison.
--2 Shown by a simile.

औपम्यं [उपमा-ष्यञ्] Comparison,
resemblance, analogy; आत्मौपम्येन
भूतेषु दयां कुर्वंति साधवः

;
करका ˚रुभगः
v. l.

औपयज a. (जी f.) [
उपयज्-अण्] Belonging to the sentences
called उपयज्, q. v.

औपयिक a. (की f.) [उपाय-ठक्]
1 Proper, fit, right.
--2 Obtained by
efforts.
--कः --कं A means, an
expedient, remedy; शिवमौपयिकं गरीयसीं
औपायिक = औपयिक q. v.

औपयौगिक a. (की f.) [
[]
उपयोगठञ्] Relating to the employment
or application (of anything).

औपराजिक a. [उपराज-ठक्]
Belonging to a viceroy.

औपरिष्ट a. (ष्टी f.) [उपरिष्ट-अण्]
Bieng or produced above.

औपरैधिकः A staff made of the
wood of the Pīlu tree.

औपरो(रौ)धिक a. (की f.)
[उपरोध-ठक्]
1 Proceeding from or
relating to favour or kindness.
--2
Opposing, impeding.
--कः A staff of the
wood of the Pīlu tree.

औपरो(रौ)धिक a. (की f.)
[उपरोध-ठक्]
1 Proceeding from or
relating to favour or kindness.
--2
Opposing, impeding.
--कः A staff of the
wood of the Pīlu tree.

औपल a. (ली f.) [उपल-अण्]
1
Stony, of stone.
--2 Raised from
stones (as a tax).
औपवस्तं Fasting, a fast.

औपवस्त्रं [उपवस्त्र-अण्]
1 Food
suitable for a fast.
--2 Fasting.

औपवास a. (सी f.) [उपवास-अण्]
Given during fasting (money); to
be done during fast.

औपवासिक a. (की f.)
[उपवास-ठञ्] Fit for fasting; able to fast.
औपवास्यं Fasting.

औपवाह्य a. [उपवाह्य स्वार्थे अण्]
1 Serving for riding on.
--2 Drawn
for pleasure (as a carriage).
--ह्यः
1 A king's elephant.
--2 Any royal
vehicle.

औपवेशिक a. (की f.) [
उपवेशठञ्] Getting livelihood by entire
devotion to any employment.

औपश्लेषिक a. (की f.) [
उपश्लेषठक्] Relating to close or
immediate contact.

औपसंक्रमण a. (णी f.)
(Anything) proper to be done at the
Upasaṃkramaṇa.

औपसंख्यानिक a. (की f.) [
उपसंख्यान-ठक्]
1 Mentioned in a
supplementary addition.
--2
Supplementary.

औपसदः [उपसद्-अण्]
1 An
अध्याय or अनुवाक containing the word
उपसद्.
--2 N. of a ceremony lasting
for one day.

औपसर्गिक a. (की f.) [
उपसर्गठञ्]
1 Able to cope with
adversity.
--2 Portentous.
--3 Relating to
change &c.
--4 Superinduced (as a
disease).
--5 Connected with a
preposition.
--कः Irregular action
of the humours of the body,
[]
producing cold sweats &c. (वातादिसन्निपात).

औपस्थान (नी f.) [उपस्थान-ण]
One whose business is to serve,
wait on, or worship.

औपस्थानिक a. (की f.) [उपस्थान-ठक्]
Living by waiting on or
worshipping.

औपस्थिक a. [उपस्थ-ठक्] Living
by fornication.

औपस्थ्यं [उपस्थ-ष्यञ्] Cohabitation,
sexual intercourse.

औपहारिक^1 a. (की f.) [
उपहारठक्] Serving as an oblation or
offering.
--कं An offering or
oblation.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

औपाध्यायक a. (की f.) [
उपाध्याय-वुञ्] Coming or obtained from
a teacher.

औपानह्य a. [उपानह्-ञ्य]
1 Used
for making shoes.
--2 To be tied or
bound on (as leather &c.).

औपासन a. (नी f.) [उपासन-अण्]
1 Relating to गृह्याग्नि or household
fire.
--2 Belonging to worship or
service, holy, sacred.
--नः
1 A fire
used for domestic worship.
--2 A
small rice-ball (पिंड) offered to the
manes.
